blurb: PŌZEN Yoga offers non-heated yoga sessions in two distinct studio spaces: a bright space for invigorating flow yoga and a dark haven for relaxation and stretch yoga. Classes are intentionally small to allow more room to breathe and reduce anxieties associated with group practice. Mats and props are provided, and the studio offers a serene and supportive environment for all levels of practitioners.
